Root.value.semantic: controlled open item values (always an array, even when multiple is false)

Root.multiple.semantic: allow several items open at once

Root.hiddenUntilFound.semantic: hidden='until-found'; overrides keepMounted; keeps closed panel mounted and searchable

Root.loopFocus.semantic: DEPRECATED no-op following the APG roving-focus removal; does not affect keyboard focus

Root.orientation.semantic: DEPRECATED no-op for focus behavior; still reflected as data-orientation

Item.value.semantic: identifies the item for controlled value/defaultValue

Item.onOpenChange.semantic: per-item change callback in addition to Root.onValueChange

dataAttributes: Panel: data-open, data-orientation, data-disabled, data-index (number), data-starting-style, data-ending-style
renderProp: Per-part `render` (ReactElement | (props, state) => ReactElement) via useRender; state props become data-* attributes.
controlled: Root is controlled via `value: Value[]` / `defaultValue: Value[]` with `onValueChange(value, eventDetails)`; per-item `onOpenChange(open, eventDetails)` also exists. Trigger state exposes hidden/index/open/value/disabled/orientation. No handle/actionsRef.
formIntegration: None — no hidden inputs or form validation. Trigger renders a native <button> inside <Accordion.Header> (an <h3> by default).
keyboard: NO roving focus and NO Arrow-key navigation between headers: docs and types both deprecate `loopFocus` and `orientation` following the w3c/aria-practices#3434 update ('This prop no longer affects keyboard focus behavior'). Navigation is plain DOM tab order; Enter/Space on the native button toggles the panel. Header renders <h3> so heading semantics come from the part, not from your markup.
notableDifferences: Roving tabindex / Arrow navigation was explicitly removed — do not port React Aria arrow-key behaviour onto Base UI Accordion. loopFocus and orientation are deprecated no-ops (orientation still drives data-orientation styling).
Value model is always an array (`Value[]`) even when `multiple` is false.
Two change callbacks: Root.onValueChange(value, details) and per-Item onOpenChange(open, details).
hiddenUntilFound / keepMounted for find-in-page and DOM retention (no React Aria analogue).
Panel animation via data-starting-style/data-ending-style + --accordion-panel-height instead of render-prop styles.
Structure is Root > Item > Header + Panel, where Header renders a real heading element and wraps the Trigger.
